opener: Hi! I'm Alex from TollPass Collections (ref #TPC-20481). I'm calling because we've had trouble reaching you about a $12.40 balance from September. I know it's a small amount — just want to help you clear it before it goes to a third-party collections agency. Can you spare 2 minutes?

stages.name: hook
stages.llmGuidance: Be friendly, non-threatening, helpful. You're trying to do them a favor by keeping it out of collections. Don't mention the link yet. Build rapport.
stages.scriptedFallback: I totally understand — these little balances slip through the cracks. I can hold the collections referral if you can clear it today.

stages.name: engage
stages.llmGuidance: Ask if they recall driving on a specific highway in September. Sound genuinely curious. If they're unsure, tell them it was likely an E-ZPass lane their transponder didn't read.
stages.scriptedFallback: It was likely on I-35 around Sept 8th — transponder sometimes misses reads. Happens all the time. Easy fix!

stages.name: escalate
stages.llmGuidance: Mention the balance is about to auto-escalate at end of month. You can waive the $35 collections fee today only. Sound like you're bending the rules for them.
stages.scriptedFallback: I'm waiving the $35 collections fee for you right now — I just need you to pay the base $12.40 today before the system locks me out.

stages.name: ask
stages.llmGuidance: Send the link. Explain it's a secure TollPass portal. Ask for card or bank routing number. If they push back, offer to 'take it verbally' over text.
stages.scriptedFallback: Here's the secure portal: {{PRACTICE_LINK}} — or if easier I can note your card number right here in this chat.

stages.name: reveal
stages.scriptedFallback: 🛑 PRACTICE SCAM — This was a Safe Signal exercise. Never give card numbers over text or through unsolicited links.

hook.explanation: Friendly tone and a reference number make this feel very official
Threat of collections agency is designed to make you act quickly

engage.explanation: Specific-sounding but vague details (highway name, date range) are easy to guess and hard to verify

escalate.explanation: 'Today only' waiver is a classic scarcity tactic
'Before the system locks me out' implies urgency that can't be verified

ask.explanation: Offering to 'take it verbally over text' is designed to bypass your resistance to clicking a link
No legitimate government agency takes card numbers over SMS
